subject.title: Clarify status of optional bird transport

question: Should Birdclaw docs now treat `xurl` as the public new-user live transport and describe `bird` as private/existing-install-only, or will `bird` get a new public distribution path?
rationale: The source still supports bird and older owner context says bird is private, but current user-facing docs still advertise a deprecated npm install and 404 repository, so the exact public support stance needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Document xurl public default
options.body: Keep bird code paths for existing users, but update public docs to make xurl the new-user path and mark bird as private or advanced existing-install-only until a public path exists.

options.title: Restore public bird distribution
options.body: Undeprecate or republish the bird package/repository, then keep Birdclaw docs pointing users at the restored public install path.

options.title: Pause docs changes
options.body: Leave the current docs unchanged until the external bird package/repository policy is resolved, accepting the current setup confusion.

recommendation.title: Document xurl public default
recommendation.body: Keep bird code paths for existing users, but update public docs to make xurl the new-user path and mark bird as private or advanced existing-install-only until a public path exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision depends on the steipete-owned bird package/repository status and on Birdclaw's public transport recommendation.
